text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Hiyori, on her way back to Landosol after finishing up a job,
finds herself under attack by a particularly tough monster.
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕事を終えてランドソルへ帰る途中、
ヒヨリは突如現れた魔物に襲われていた。

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GROOOAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Urgh...!
text_block_list.orig_text: くっ……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: It ain't over yet!
text_block_list.orig_text: まだまだぁ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
That said, this monster's way tougher than usual!
I might actually lose at this rate...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この魔物、
すごく強い！？
このままじゃ……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Knight?!
How come you're here?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士くん！？
どうしてここに！？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Right, good point. Let's waste this thing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだった！　
まずは魔物を倒さないとだね！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Rrrrghhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Phew... Down it goes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ……
終わったぁ……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the help, Mr. Knight!
Honestly, that was just a bit too close for comfort. Ehehe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士くん、
助けてくれてありがとう！
もうちょっと後だったら、
やられちゃってたかも……
えへへ。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you just happened to be in the area?
Either way, I still owe you one!
text_block_list.orig_text:
偶然通りがかっただけ？
それでも騎士くんが来てくれて、
ホントに良かったよー！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
I'd have bailed if you were even a second slower.
That thing was brutal.
text_block_list.orig_text:
戦ってたのが凶暴な魔物だったから、
あたし逃げようかと思ったんだ……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? You owed me one for last time?
Hey, not true at all!
We both helped each other out back then!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
この前のお返し……？
それならお互いさまさまだよ！
あの時は、あたしも助けてもらったし！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess I owe you one now.
Wouldn't be right to leave things as is.
So yeah, give me a call if you need anything!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
今度はあたしがお返ししないとだね！
助けてもらったお礼！
なにか困ったら、
あたしが助けてあげるね！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Oh come on, no need to hold back.
You can say no all you want, but that won't stop me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇ～、
遠慮しないでよ！
ダメって言われても、
絶対にお返しするからね！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
What's that? You're just gonna repay me in turn?
Ahh, so that's how you're gonna play it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなら、
お返しのお返しするって……？
むー、
そう来たかー

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: In that case, I'm just gonna have to repay you for repaying me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあじゃあ、
あたしはお返しのお返しのお返しを──

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there's way too much repayment going on here.
I'm starting to lose track, haha.
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
なんかお返しばっかりで、
わけわかんなくなっちゃうね。
えへへ。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
In fact, this might go on forever if we keep at it.
Especially since we keep helping each other out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
このままじゃ、
お返しのループから抜け出せなくなっちゃうね。
いっつも助けたり助けられたり……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Not too bad in and of itself,
but there has to be a better way to handle it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それも悪くない気がするけど、
他にもできることがあるような……？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how about this?
There's two of us, so let's make the most of it.
Plenty of other people could do with our help.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
ひらめいた！
だったら、
あたしと騎士くん二人で、
一緒に誰かを助ければいいんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good, right?
That'll break us out of this loop nice and good.
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人で他の人を助けるなら、
お返しがずっと続くこともなくなるでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna help someone out, then I'll join you.
And if I wanna help someone out, you can join me.
Makes sense, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士くんが誰かを助けたい時は、
あたしが手伝う！
あたしが誰かを助けたい時には、
騎士くんが手伝う！
っていうのは、
どうかな？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Awesome!
Sorted, then!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だよね！
じゃあ、
決まりだね！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Huh?! D-don't tell me I got too ahead of myself...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え！？　
ダ、
ダメだったかな……？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
We need to sort out how to get in touch with each other first?
Wait, you're already thinking that far ahead?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
連絡方法をどうするか決めないと……？
もうそこまで考えてるのっ！？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Glad that you're on board with this.
Hmm. How about we make it official, though? 
With a pinky promise, of course!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士くんも乗り気で良かったー！
じゃあ、
指切りしようよ、
指切り！
ほら、
小指出して！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Bit hard to do that like this, though.
Gimme a sec... There we go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしの小指？
ちょっと待っててね。
よいしょっと……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I bet you thought they were real paws.
But nope! They're just gloves.
Anyway, let's get on with it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは！　
びっくりした？
実はあれ、
グローブなんだ！
ほらっ、
いくよ？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Pinky pinky promise!
A broken promise means a broken finger!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゆーびきーりげんまんっ！
嘘ついたら針千本のーますっ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: It's official now, so no going back on it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
約束だからね？　
破っちゃダメだよ？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
That said, I know you wouldn't break a promise.
So let's help as many people as we can!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これからもよろしくね、
騎士くん！
二人でたくさんの人を助けよーっ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Oh, we weren't done yet. Ehehe.
There we go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あっ、
指切りの途中だったね……
えへへっ。
ゆーびきった！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0}, knowing how important this promise was,
swore to himself that he would never break it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうしてヒヨリと誓った約束を守っていこうと
心の中で決意する{0}だった。
